assessment: This is an important study that aims to investigate the behavioral relevance of multisensory responses recorded in the auditory cortex. The experiments are elegant and well-designed and are supported by appropriate analyses of the data. Although solid evidence is presented that is consistent with learning-dependent encoding of visual information in auditory cortex, further work is needed to establish the origin and nature of these non-auditory signals and to definitively rule out any effects of movement-related activity.
